error.no_match: matches none of the allowed forms
error.not_object: settings must be a JSON object
error.literal_secret: looks like a literal secret; keep secrets out of the settings file and use the credentials file or the environment
error.url_scheme: must start with http:// or https://
error.fingerprint_format: must be sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hex digits
error.too_large: the file is larger than {limit} bytes

plan.header: [Current plan - internal, do not quote verbatim]
plan.required: This goal needs several steps. Before calling any other tool, call update_plan with short steps (initial status pending), then update their status (in_progress, done, failed, skipped) as you work.
plan.resumed: The plan from the previous turn still has open steps. If the new request has the same goal, continue those steps and do not repeat steps that are done. If the goal is different, call update_plan with a new plan.
plan.incomplete: The plan still has open steps: {open}. Finish them, or update their status (done, skipped, failed) with a reason through update_plan, or say clearly which part could not be done.

reflect.step_failed: The last step did not get anywhere: {issues}. {left} replans left. Change approach (other keywords, another tool, another source) and update the plan through update_plan, or conclude clearly that no evidence was found.
reflect.permanent: {issues}. Other keywords or tools cannot help. Do not call that tool again. Answer directly and say clearly that there is no data to answer from, with how to fix it (for example ingest documents).
reflect.budget_out: The replans are used up. Do not retry the same way. Answer with what you have and say clearly what is missing and why.

loop.tool_not_allowed: This tool is not allowed in the active workflow.
loop.too_many_calls: Too many calls in one step.
loop.cyclic: Stopped: the same tool call was repeated.
loop.max_steps: Stopped: the allowed steps ran out before a final answer. Say whether to continue.
loop.timeout: Stopped: the time for one turn ran out.
loop.provider_error: The model API could not be reached. Check the model server and try again.
loop.interrupted: The call was cut off before its result was recorded; it may or may not have run.

login.title: Sign in to Laris
login.no_server: No server address is set. Set server.url in {settings} or LARIS_SERVER__URL, then sign in.
login.rejected: The server did not accept this key. Check it and try again.
login.unreachable: Could not reach {server}: {detail}. The key was not saved.
login.invalid_key: That is not a usable key: {detail}.
login.saved: Signed in as {role}. The key is saved in {path}.
login.signed_out: Signed out. The saved key was removed.
login.other_server: The saved key was accepted by another server ({server}); sign in again for this one.
login.from_environment: The key comes from LARIS_API_KEY; the environment wins over the saved key.
login.needs_pipe: Pipe the key in, for example: printf '%s' "$KEY" | laris login. The interface login form hides what you type.
login.save_failed: The server accepted the key, but it could not be saved: {detail}
